goal: Stops invalidateblock from reporting success when block disconnection fails and leaves a partial rollback
Explicitly rejects attempts to invalidate the genesis block with an invalid parameter error
agreement: Supports routing disconnection failures through state rather than reporting success (yusufyildiz34)
Suggests documenting partial rollback as a known limitation instead of adding regression code (l0rinc)
Requested simplifying tests and expanding the pull request description (l0rinc, pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because invalidateblock is an administrative and testing tool rather than an everyday RPC method
Prevents callers from assuming a rollback succeeded when block disconnection actually failed

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it improves error accounting during rollbacks without altering consensus rules
Surfaces disconnection failures in BlockValidationState instead of silently ignoring them
